dataset.name: Copenhagen cutaneous-melanoma ACT cohort (GSE100797)
dataset.description: Independent stage-IV cutaneous-melanoma cohort with pre-ACT bulk tumor RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The phase I/II adoptive T-cell therapy study analyzed pre-ACT tumor material from 27 patients. Public gene-level expression is available for 25. To preserve the TCGA-SKCM disease definition, TRACE Explorer further restricts eligibility to the 17 patients whose source record identifies a cutaneous primary, excluding two mucosal and six unknown-primary melanomas.

metadata.source_program: Copenhagen phase I/II adoptive T-cell therapy trial NCT00937625
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and the CC BY 4.0 publication
metadata.library_method: Pre-ACT metastatic-tumor RNA processed with TopHat2 and Cufflinks 2.1.1; isoform FPKM values were summed to genes, quantile normalized and transformed with log2(value + 1)
metadata.endpoint_context: Overall survival in previously treated stage-IV cutaneous melanoma receiving adoptive T-cell therapy
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The article and GEO provide the locked ACT-trial survival values but do not restate the exact calendar origin in the deposited expression record. TRACE Explorer therefore exposes source-provided OS without equating it to an untreated natural-history endpoint.
metadata.sample_selection_note: All retained profiles precede ACT. The source notes that some tumors were obtained after or during prior BRAF-targeted therapy; this treatment context remains visible and the release must not be interpreted as treatment-naive melanoma.
metadata.disease_selection_note: Only source records with type.of.primary = skin are eligible. Mucosal and unknown-primary tumors are excluded before endpoint QC even though their expression is public.
metadata.overlap_note: This adoptive-cell-therapy cohort is distinct from the Hugo, Riaz and Gide checkpoint-inhibitor cohorts already represented in the catalog.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO matrix in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Metastatic cutaneous-melanoma tumor sampled before adoptive T-cell therapy

expression.label: Source quantile-normalized log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The pinned matrix contains 18,418 unique non-empty source gene symbols.
expression.scale_note: The source summed transcript FPKM to gene level, quantile normalized across samples and applied log2(value + 1). TRACE Explorer retains those values without an additional transform and restricts analysis to the 17 cutaneous-primary records.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: ACT trial follow-up; exact calendar origin not restated in the deposited expression record
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause; living patients are censored at the source-locked follow-up
